about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: John R. Moolenaar

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: WHOLE MILK FOR HEALTHY KIDS ACT OF 2025
statements.title: WHOLE MILK FOR HEALTHY KIDS ACT OF 2025
sentences: Today, I rise in support of the Whole Milk for Healthy Kids Act.
I thank the chairman for his leadership on this legislation, and I urge all my colleague to support it.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ADAMS MEMORIAL-GREAT AMERICAN HEROES ACT
statements.title: ADAMS MEMORIAL-GREAT AMERICAN HEROES ACT
sentences: Today, I rise in support of H.R. 2306, the Adams Memorial-Great American Heroes Act.
I urge all my colleagues to support this bipartisan legislation.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: TRANSPARENCY IN REPORTING OF ADVERSARIAL CONTRIBUTIONS TO EDUCATION ACT
statements.title: TRANSPARENCY IN REPORTING OF ADVERSARIAL CONTRIBUTIONS TO EDUCATION ACT
sentences: Parents may think the Chinese Communist Party isn't interested in what their kids are learning, but the CCP wants to influence every American.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to vote for the bills.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SHANDRA EISENGA HUMAN CELL AND TISSUE PRODUCT SAFETY ACT
statements.title: SHANDRA EISENGA HUMAN CELL AND TISSUE PRODUCT SAFETY ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of this bipartisan legislation, H.R. 1082, the Shandra Eisenga Human Cell and Tissue Product Safety Act.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support this vital bipartisan legislation in honor of Shandra and her family.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DHS RESTRICTIONS ON CONFUCIUS INSTITUTES AND CHINESE ENTITIES OF CONCERN ACT
statements.title: DHS RESTRICTIONS ON CONFUCIUS INSTITUTES AND CHINESE ENTITIES OF CONCERN ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, this legislation is about one thing, and that is protecting American students, American research, and America's future from malign foreign influence, especially from the Chinese Communist Party.
They are trying to shape how young Americans see the world and to rewrite the story of the Chinese Communist Party one classroom at a time.
If we want taxpayer dollars, we cannot partner with a foreign adversary.
As chairman of the Select Committee on the Chinese Communist Party, I can tell you the threat is real, and the evidence is overwhelming.
Mr. Speaker, I rise today in strong support of Representative Pfluger's bipartisan bill, H.R. 881, the DHS Restrictions on Confucius Institutes and Chinese Entities of Concern Act.
